title: Liaodi Pagoda (Kaiyuan Temple Pagoda), Dingzhou
summary: The Liaodi, or Kaiyuan Temple, Pagoda is an 11-storey octagonal pagoda at Dingzhou in Hebei, China. Emperor Zhenzong commissioned it in 1001 for defence against the Khitans, and it was finished in 1055 after decades of work. China Daily calls it the highest surviving masonry pagoda in China and gives its height as 84.2 metres.

uncertainty.note: China Daily: commissioned 1001, completed 1055. Start is the commission year; building took decades. End is the present: the pagoda still stands.
